book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: المحيط الهادي كبير، والرحلة اتنين وعشرين يوم.
sentences.en: The Pacific is big, and the crossing twenty-two days.
And the General Grant a big, fast steamer.
And nothing happened.
No storm, no trouble.

sentences.ar: وفوغ يلعب ورق مع ركاب، وعودا تتفرج.
sentences.en: And Fogg played cards with passengers, Aouda watching.
And Passepartout quarrelled with the cook.
And Fix walked the deck, thinking.
And Aouda was changing.
At first, she had been grateful.
And then, she became interested.
And then, something else.

sentences.ar: كانت تتطلع بفوغ لما ما يشوف.
sentences.en: She watched Fogg when he was not looking.
And asked Passepartout about him.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو يقول: ما بعرف عنه شي.
sentences.en: And Passepartout would say: I know nothing about him.

sentences.ar: بس بعرف إنه أحسن رجل بالدنيا.
sentences.en: But I know he is the best man in the world.
And Fogg?
No one knew what he thought.
He sat with her every evening.

sentences.ar: ويحكي عن الطقس، وعن الوقت، وعن الطريق.
sentences.en: And talked of the weather, the time, the route.
And never once spoke of himself.

sentences.ar: وباسبارتو قال لحاله: لو كان إله قلب، كان بيّن.
sentences.en: And Passepartout said to himself: if he had a heart, it would show.
And then remembered the elephant, and the pyre.
And said: he has a heart.
But hides it well.
And on 3 December, America appeared.
Mountains, then a city, then a harbour.
San Francisco.
And Fogg calculated: 3 December.
We have eighteen days.
New York seven days.
And the sea nine.
Total sixteen.
Two days to spare.
And Passepartout looked at his watch.
Still on London time.

sentences.ar: وكانت غلطانة اتناعشر ساعة، بس هو ما كان يعرف.
sentences.en: And it was twelve hours wrong, but he did not know.
